Style fields and keep focus visible

Use font: inherit for controls to match surrounding text. Add padding for a comfortable target. :focus-visible lets keyboard users see which control is active.

How to try it Save this example as a new .html file, then open it in your browser. After a change, save and reload.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Style fields and keep focus visible</title>
  <style>
form { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 300px; }
input, button { font: inherit; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #497676; border-radius: 6px; }
button { background: #006767; color: white; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a13a00; outline-offset: 2px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<form><label for="name">Order name</label><input id="name" name="name"><button type="button">Continue</button></form>
</body>
</html>

What to expect Click inside the preview, then use Tab to move between the field and button and see the outline.

Align prices and stripe table rows

border-collapse: collapse merges adjacent borders. tbody tr:nth-child(even) selects every second row in the table body. Right-align prices so their digits line up.

How to try it Save this example as a new .html file, then open it in your browser. After a change, save and reload.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Align prices and stripe table rows</title>
  <style>
table { width: 100%; max-width: 360px; border-collapse: collapse; }
th, td { padding: 8px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #888; }
tr > :last-child { text-align: right; }
tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #def5f5; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<table><caption>Product price list</caption>
<thead><tr><th scope="col">Product</th><th scope="col">Price (MMK)</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>Pen</td><td>1,500</td></tr><tr><td>Desk Lamp</td><td>2,500</td></tr></tbody></table>
</body>
</html>

What to expect The second product row is colored and both prices line up at the right.
